content:
marie: Quick heads-up — our siena7b int4 canary is failing with OOMs and higher tail latency on long docs.

aj: saw the spikes. reproducer: 3 concurrent requests, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=512 -> fragment + kv growth :thinking:

sasha: quality check running now. Quick note: quantization noise looks small on short prompts, but for long completions truncation increased.

marie: stack snippet from the canary logs:
```
2026-03-21T14:12:03Z ERROR cuda OOM while allocating KV cache for layer 32
prefetch=on batch=3 max_new_tokens=512 seq_len=2048
```

aj: immediate mitigation: lower max_new_tokens default to 256 for the canary, drop batch_size to 2, enable kv_trim on eviction <0.85

sasha: I'll run the eval suite (long-doc completion + summarization) against int8 and int4 variants. If int8 avoids truncation we might prefer that for doc-heavy customers.

marie: proposed config patch (canary-only):
```yaml
model: siena7b
quant: int4
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  batch_size: 2
  prefetch: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.85
  warmup_slots: 1
```

ops-ryan: rolling the canary with that patch now. deploy-bot: starting canary deploy 4781234567 -> 4781234568 :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started (3 hosts) — health checks passing

aj: after deploy I'll collect heap profiles and KV histograms. if frag persists we'll try slot reservation tweak + soft-throttle.

sasha: ETA on evals ~45m. will post regression numbers and example prompts.

marie: thanks — if anyone sees errors tag me. consider adding a fallback route in routing policy to int8 variant until we confirm stability :thumbsup:
